findings.problem: RETURN says the worker chose the local browser form because the original request left it open. Root explicitly selected local GUI and trim/exact matching before dispatch; RESULT.md:9 already correctly attributes the implementation form to the coordinator. The return therefore misstates who resolved a known-open choice. This matters when the report is read back as evidence of what was authorized versus independently chosen by the worker; it is not a functional code failure.

codeAssessment.result: Both exact mappings are complete: HINK-E0213 -> Good Display GDEH0213B1 / SSD1673 / ssd16xx / reel_board; HINK-E0213A22 -> Good Display GDEH0213B72 / SSD1675A / ssd16xx / reel_board@2. All four result fields have corresponding DOM targets and labels. No PCB revision or third variant is used to select a row.

Normalization is String.trim only, followed by entry.label===label. No prefix/case/hyphen/fuzzy correction exists. describe returns entry:null for empty/unknown input. Every render overwrites all four displayed values with either the current match or an em dash, so a previous target is not retained on backspace, case/PCB/unknown input, clear or Escape. Input changes render synchronously; submit prevents navigation and rerenders. Escape and clear explicitly clear input and redraw.

The Low Power wording preserves both the nominal description and the explicit always-on/no-saving limitation as documentary content. It is filled outside the per-input match branch and never hidden by an unknown result. The page identifies a fixed source commit and disclaims current-board/physical verification. There is no build, flashing, sensor/circuit/power control or hardware-measurement implementation.

Input echo and values use textContent; the only link target is the fixed source URL. No source/HTML interpolation, provider call or automatic update path appears. CSP disables connections/form action and loads only local scripts/styles. Following the explicit external documentation link is user navigation, not an automatic lookup network dependency.

reportAndTestScope.truthBoundary: RESULT/RETURN identify the code commit, supplied fixed document/table as source, prototype-only scope and no AgentFlow app/deployment/hardware work. Author Node/browser/mutation-test claims are expressly author observations, with root independent checks listed as not yet received at that report revision. This reviewer cannot independently certify the author's reported executions from source inspection alone; no unsupported execution conclusion was added.
reportAndTestScope.testMeaning: Lookup tests cover exact two-row values, prefix collisions, trim/case/Unicode/hyphen/PCB variants and no-target states. Fake-DOM app tests meaningfully exercise overwrite-on-transition, clear/Escape/submit and literal HTML-like input. They do not verify real layout, accessibility, real clipboard or browser behavior; the comments and report distinguish those limits. Test source is consistent with the described behavior, but was not rerun by this reviewer.
reportAndTestScope.rootExecutionReportedSeparately: After the code review, root reported Windows Node24.19 tests20pass and real IAB1280 checks of both mappings, valid-to-unknown backspace, whitespace/case/PCB/HTML/Escape/Tab, no1280x720 overflow in observed states and no console warnings/errors. Root judged the instruction copy somewhat long but four values/Low Power readable together. These are root's independent observations, not executions performed by this reviewer.

limits: Static functional review plus root's bounded observations support only this local prototype and selected normalization policy. They do not validate physical reel board behavior, current distribution variants or a full AgentFlow product release.

The exact matching policy intentionally rejects unsupported case/hyphen/similar-character/prefix variants and only trims ECMAScript boundary whitespace. This is a chosen implementation constraint, not a recovered source requirement.
No comprehensive cross-browser, Windows font, assistive-technology or arbitrary-length-input usability claim is independently established here. Author expressly records the long-input scroll limit.
Existing109 request and107 failure remain immutable. The report attribution correction must not rewrite the original open-form request or turn root's subsequent choice into original source evidence.
